name: Credit risk
description: Risk of loss from a borrower or counterparty failing to meet an obligation.

name: Counterparty credit risk
description: Risk that a counterparty to a market or treasury transaction defaults before final settlement.

name: Market risk
description: Risk of loss from movements in market prices, including foreign exchange.

name: Interest-rate risk
description: Risk from changes in interest rates affecting earnings or economic value.

name: Liquidity risk
description: Risk that the customer or the bank cannot meet cash-flow obligations when due.

name: Operational risk
description: Risk of loss from inadequate or failed processes, people or systems.

name: Technology risk
description: Risk arising from technology failures, change or third-party technology services.

name: Cyber risk
description: Risk of loss or disruption from unauthorised digital access or attacks.

name: Concentration risk
description: Risk from uneven distribution of exposure by customer, group, industry or country.

name: Country risk
description: Risk associated with the economic, legal and transfer conditions of a jurisdiction.

name: Industry risk
description: Risk associated with the conditions of a customer's industry.

name: Collateral risk
description: Risk that collateral or other mitigants are insufficient, ineligible or unenforceable.

name: Legal risk
description: Risk from contracts, disputes, enforceability or legal change.

name: Reputation risk
description: Risk of adverse perception affecting the fictional bank or the relationship.

name: Strategic risk
description: Risk that the relationship or business plan does not achieve its stated objectives.

name: Climate risk
description: Physical and transition climate-related financial risk indicators.

name: Model risk
description: Risk from incorrect or misused models, including this demonstration score.

name: Data risk
description: Risk from incomplete, stale, contradictory or poorly controlled data.

name: AML risk
description: Synthetic anti-money-laundering indicators requiring qualified human review.

name: Terrorist-financing risk
description: Synthetic indicators relevant to terrorist financing. No legal conclusion is made.

name: Proliferation-financing risk
description: Synthetic indicators relevant to proliferation financing. No legal conclusion is made.

name: Sanctions risk
description: Synthetic sanctions-screening status. The model cannot clear an alert.

name: Fraud risk
description: Synthetic fraud indicators. The model does not determine guilt or intent.

name: Conduct risk
description: Risk that the relationship is conducted in a way that causes poor customer outcomes.
